scope: Repository-owned free abelian gauge control on R x T3, tensored with K1335's spherical principal-series Hilbert fibre; not the GU action or its constraint complex.

detour_complex.spacetime: M=R_t x T3_x with ultrastatic Lorentz metric
detour_complex.brst_rule: s A=d c and s c=0
detour_complex.common_core: compactly time-supported smooth forms with finite spatial Fourier support and K-finite internal values
detour_complex.spatial_domain: zero-mean H2(T3;H_ps)-valued one-forms with H1 form domain

mode_control.zero_mode_disposition: excluded from the linear control to remove harmonic flat-potential degeneracy

claim_ceiling: The positive principal-series Hilbert fibre admits a standard nontrivial free Maxwell detour/BRST control with exact gauge identities and a common zero-mean Sobolev domain. This is not the GU action, not interacting and not a source-derived BV-BFV complex.
